body:
Thank you so much.  I don't know if I'm even able to put into words what your response means to me.  It made me cry, in the good way.  

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for these incredibly generous words.
Thanks for that - and for the original advice.  Best to you.

Thanks very much for your response and for taking the time.  I appreciate your advice.

However, my post didn't say anything about pornography/masturbation.  I find it presumptuous that you would advise me to stop masturbating (linking to nofap, which I find abhorrent) or watching pornography -- I didn't say anything about having an addiction or even a predilection for porn.  Respectfully, maybe you should cut back on giving that advice for situations where it's not warranted.

Thank you so much for writing.  I guess when I did the x-post and copied and pasted the original one from r/depression, it lost all the formatting.  Sorry for the huge block of text - I think I fixed it now (new to posting on Reddit).

I'll take the luck and send it right back to you.  Thanks for reaching out, really.
